\documentclass{article}\usepackage{tikz,enumitem}\begin{document}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, itemsep=14pt]
  \item $a=6$, $b=8$. Find $c$.
    \begin{tikzpicture}\node at (0,0) {$b=8$};\node at (1,0) {$a=6$};\end{tikzpicture}
  \item $a=5$, $c=13$. Find $b$.
  \item $a=7$, $b=24$. Find $c$.
\end{enumerate}
% list 2: a macro-style figure WITH an optional [..] arg on only one of two
% items — must be detected as a valued figure despite the [scale=..], so the
% all-or-nothing rule fires (run_tests.sh greps for the "list 2" fault; if
% the optional arg defeated detection this list would falsely pass)
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, itemsep=4cm]
  \item \rtfig[scale=1.1]{$a=6$}{$b=8$}{$c=?$} Find $c$.
  \item $a=5$, $c=13$. Find $b$.
\end{enumerate}\end{document}
